subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram album sending as a new message-tool action/parameter, or keep the existing mediaUrls contract and make the Telegram plugin group eligible outbound media automatically?
rationale: This is a user-facing message-tool/channel API shape decision, and the open draft proposes a new action name while current main already has a general mediaUrls contract that could be implemented channel-locally.

options.title: Use existing mediaUrls
options.body: Keep the current message-tool contract and implement album grouping inside Telegram delivery for eligible media lists.

options.title: Add explicit album action
options.body: Accept a new Telegram-specific action or parameter and document it as an intentional channel capability.

options.title: Defer album grouping
options.body: Keep sequential fan-out only and leave true albums out of scope until stronger live proof or product demand appears.

recommendation.title: Use existing mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Keep the current message-tool contract and implement album grouping inside Telegram delivery for eligible media lists.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current source-history signal on the Telegram send/action files and already participated in the issue cleanup discussion.
